checkpoint_regime: existing task-trained seven-backbone SEARCH selected checkpoint, frozen during extraction
token_hook: CBraModAdapter.model.encoder output before Identity proj_out and mean(dim=(1,2))

roles.TRAIN_GEOMETRY: inner_train_subjects, sessions 1 and 2; token scores and all selection only
roles.CHECKPOINT_VALIDATION: inner_val_subjects; inventory only, historically checkpoint-selection exposed
roles.OUTER_DEVELOPMENT: outer_dev_subjects, session 2; evaluation only, historically exposed development cohort
roles.FINAL_HELDOUT: not opened; formal EEG reads exactly zero

normalization: exact seven-backbone checkpoint source-session-1 channelwise mean/std; applied without refit to session 2
native_input: 250 Hz normalized OpenBMI cache resampled with scipy.signal.resample_poly(4,5) to 200 Hz; 4 non-overlapping 200-sample patches
primary_reliability: mean biological-subject cosine between within-subject session-1 and session-2 binary class-centroid direction for each token
descriptive_reliability: negative absolute session log norm ratio
utility_probe: C=1 deterministic L2 logistic fitted on other TRAIN subjects session 1 token; held TRAIN subject session 2 subject-equal BA
utility_erasure: held TRAIN subject session-2 BA loss after each token is replaced by TRAIN session-1 neutral centroid in a frozen all-token linear decoder
primary_utility_for_selection: utility_probe; erasure is descriptive corroboration, never OUTER-selected
score_combination: TRAIN-token z-score of primary cosine reliability plus TRAIN-token z-score of primary utility_probe
decoder_family: deterministic L2 logistic regression with TRAIN-only feature scaling
selection: biological-subject-grouped TRAIN LOSO, scores recomputed without each held TRAIN subject for predictive LOSO; source-session-1 fit, held-subject session-2 evaluation; deterministic tie breaks
gate_C_primary_pooling: RELIABLE_UTILITY_TOPK; RU_WEIGHTED and RU_TWO_STREAM are separate prespecified diagnostics
gate_A: per-fold top-minus-bottom quartile cosine gap >=0.20 and reliability std greater than pairing-null p95, both in at least four folds
gate_B: mean split-half Spearman >=0.50 and top-quartile Jaccard >=0.40; across-fold pairwise ranks must be descriptively consistent
gate_C: RU_TOPK minus MEAN_ALL pooled subject-equal BA >=0.015 and positive in >=4/5 folds; >=0.020 strong, <0.010 insufficient
gate_D: RU_TOPK minus UTILITY_TOPK pooled subject-equal BA >=0.005 and positive in >=4/5 folds
gate_E: RU_TOPK beats ENERGY_TOPK and p95 of 500 cardinality-matched RANDOM_TOPK; if two-stream selected, beats RANDOM_TWO_STREAM
outer_decision_policy: no formula, stage, token rank, subset cardinality, decoder C, or proposed-model family may be chosen on OUTER
forbidden: P/C projection on final pooled embedding
